{{Quote|Food can be found in many places. The most immediate source is from muja fruit bushes.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=Muja.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Muja fruit''' was an edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that grew on [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and bushes. It could be found on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was reddish-orange in color, about the size of a fist. Notable planets where they thrived included [[Reytha]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and [[Krant]]. The muja fruit could be made into [[muja juice]] and also baked into [[muja muffin]] or used as a filling in [[muja fruit-filled donut]]s. They were also sold on many planets, including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Muja fruit grew on bushes which were harvested by organic and [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] workers.

==History==
During the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] instructed several workers at a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] how to gather muja fruit and store it in the building, along with other resources. [[Food processing center]]s were also used to store muja fruit.<ref name="GB" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Now, to begin gathering food from the muja fruit bush right click on it.|Qui-Gon Jinn teaching the player to gather food|audio=MujaRightClick.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Muja fruit first appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="JA:TDH" /> Muja fruit bushes serve as a source of food in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. In the standard game mode muja fruit bushes are always generated near the player's [[command center]], and serve an identical function to berry bushes from the game [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Empires_II Age of Empires II], from which ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' reapplied many gameplay elements.<ref name="GB" />
